The objective of the course was to show how a Geographic Information System (GIS), can be an important support tool in urban analysis. The syllabus included topics such as the basics of a GIS, the types of data used by a GIS, how to integrate, edit and model the data to solve a particular problem, how to visualize the information and how to perform GIS analysis. The course was given in conjunction with SIGSA, a company dedicated to the integration of Geographic Information Systems.
